title: I Tell Me Ma
commons_title: File:I Tell Me Ma - Celtic Aire - United States Air Force Band.mp3
composition: traditional children's song from Belfast; public domain
credit: Performance by Celtic Aire, United States Air Force Band (a work of the US Government, public domain).
lyrics: I'll tell me ma when I go home
The boys won't leave the girls alone
They pulled my hair, they stole my comb
But that's all right till I go home
She is handsome, she is pretty
She is the belle of Belfast city
She is courting, one two three
Please won't you tell me, who is she?
